svg.title: ArdaBackend architecture, concepts, and programming models
svg.desc: Reference architecture showing backend initialization and ownership, shader registration and binding generation, pipeline and command recording, and platform presentation layers.
svg.text: Process-wide device bootstrap, virtual shader sources, registered shaders, cached PSOs, opaque RHI commands, and presentation
Cyan: calls | Green: created or retained data | Amber dashed: lifetime, validation, or required ordering

g.text: 1 | LAYERS AND LIFETIME - one configured backend, opaque resources, explicit ownership
own shader map, PSO cache, swap chain
includes ArdaBackend.h; never native API headers
Arda descriptors, enums, states, and results
public source boundary rejects direct implementation-library use
implementation types remain private to the linked module
returned refs retain resources through intrusive atomic AddRef / Release
device ownership checks reject cross-device resource use
TArdaRHIResult combines value and FArdaRHIStatus; no exceptions required
Core owns IArdaBackendRuntime; concrete RHI refs pin provider and native/engine lifetime
Caller owns unique_ptr<IArdaSwapChain>, FArdaGlobalShaderMap, and FArdaPipelineStateCache
RHI refs may be copied or moved; cache entries retain their pipelines and layouts
WaitForIdle → destroy swap chain and renderer-owned GPU state → ShutdownBackend
ConfigureBackend → begin shader-directory registry use → scan and freeze sources → FArdaShaderTypeRegistration::CommitAll()
→ select module → CreateDevice(config, surface, provider) → wrap provider as FArdaRHIDeviceRef → publish module
Configure before initialize | initialize once | shader mappings are immutable while a backend is live | validation defaults on
Headless initialization creates a device only; presentation initialization also consumes IArdaWindowSurface and creates a swap chain
Failure unwinds device state and releases the shader-directory registry for correction and retry
2 | SHADER PROGRAMMING MODEL - virtual source paths, static types, metadata-driven bindings
overlay roots or exclusive Unreal-style roots
all mappings must be added before backend initialization
source stem | artifact stem | entry point | stage
deferred static registration avoids initialization-order dependence
resolve virtual source; validate identity and metadata
reject duplicate names, invalid slots, and collisions
backend initialization commits before device publication
portable virtual path → canonical physical file
generated FArdaShaderParameterMetadata records member type, byte offset, array size, register, space, and visibility
BuildBindingLayoutDescs() groups descriptors into binding layouts; BuildBindingSetDesc() validates supplied resources
ApplyPushConstants() copies declared constant ranges; nested parameter structs are recursively enumerated
metadata is authored in C++; it is not recovered from DXIL or SPIR-V reflection
for every committed type: use the active module's artifact format and extension
load bytecode → IArdaRHIDevice::CreateShader → create all metadata-derived binding layouts
store pointer-stable FArdaGlobalShaderInstance { type, shader, binding layouts }
idempotent for the same device, backend, and artifact directory; Reset before changing them
explicit shader slots and visibility are preserved
missing, duplicate, or type-mismatched resources return a diagnostic status
the same metadata also bridges registered shaders into ArdaRenderGraph
initializers copy shader refs and binding layouts into complete Arda RHI pipeline descriptors
source registration identifies the shader; cache policy produces or loads the module artifact
the module may rewrite or execute compilation; core provides a DXC-compatible fallback
3 | RENDERING PROGRAMMING MODEL - immutable descriptors, lazy PSOs, explicit command submission
render-target formats may be left unresolved
debug labels do not affect descriptor identity
descriptors compare and hash by semantic state
LRU retention, Trim, Clear, stats, diagnostics
Precache warms the same cache without binding
different completed framebuffer formats form different keys
graphics and compute PSOs are owned by this cache tier
input, raster, blend, and depth state
RT / meshlet pipelines and native imports
resolve cached PSO and place it in the command state
binding sets remain explicit state inputs
push constants are applied through metadata
errors propagate as FArdaRHIStatus or callbacks
automatic barriers can be disabled for graph-managed state
one interface spans graphics, compute, copy, mesh, and RT work
event query, timer query, GPU fence, QueueWait
Borrowed-only portable native texture / buffer imports
queue capabilities expose graphics, compute, and copy availability
resource device affinity is checked before native calls
submission is explicit; recording alone creates no GPU order
Find registered shader → build parameter binding sets → create pipeline initializer → Set*PipelineState
→ Open command list → set resources and barriers → Draw or Dispatch → Close → ExecuteCommandList
ARDG owns logical lifetime, state lowering, and queue dependencies; it records the same IArdaRHICommandList API
The backend remains usable directly: the RHI does not require the render graph
4 | NATIVE PLATFORM MODULES - shared public presentation over D3D12 and Vulkan
swap images are Borrowed native texture imports
registered as native-d3d12 or native-vulkan; exact name wins
mapped into Arda RHI by FDevice wrappers
AcquireFrame(OutFramebuffer) → record rendering to the imported back buffer → Close()
Vulkan: AcquireFrame queues the image-available wait; PrepareSubmit queues the render-finished signal before execution
D3D12: PrepareSubmit is empty; Present uses IDXGISwapChain3::Present
Resize waits for idle, recreates images, imports textures, and rebuilds framebuffers
AcquireFrame returns FArdaRHIFramebufferRef, so rendering code stays platform-neutral
GetBackendError() reports initialization failure | IArdaDiagnosticCallback receives GPU API messages
ARDA_LOG provides categorized structured output | ARDA_CHECK / VERIFY / ENSURE enforce contracts
shader directory, shader registration, global map, RHI, and PSO APIs return domain-specific status
modules translate native severity into EArdaDiagnosticSeverity before callbacks
validation and diagnostics cross the abstraction boundary; native resource types do not
one process-wide device | frozen shader manifest while live | device-affine resources | immutable PSOs | explicit submission | swap chain destroyed before shutdown
Source: ArdaBackend public and private headers
